paragraphs: This case tests the limits of bankruptcy court power. The core issue is whether Article III of the Constitution prevents Congress from allowing these courts to decide certain state law claims.

paragraphs: This case defines the boundary between federal bankruptcy courts and Article III courts. It determines which judges can resolve disputes over property belonging to third parties. The outcome shapes the efficiency and constitutional limits of the federal bankruptcy system.
